title: Carbon footprint accounting of e-waste dismantling process in China: field-based research
core_idea: Develop and apply an accounting method for the carbon footprint of China's e-waste dismantling process by producing a dismantling-process carbon inventory that finely matches daily electricity consumption of key energy-using facilities with daily dismantling volumes for five types of e-waste.
tldr: Field-based method to account for carbon emissions from e-waste dismantling in China by linking facility electricity use to daily dismantling volumes to build a detailed inventory.
